purpose: Differentially specify Windows executable/batch/raw command-line semantics and refusal before execution.
behavior: Uses a corpus of empty/space/tab/quote/backslash, shell metacharacter, percent and Unicode arguments; compares raw command line with std::process and exact recovered argv/cwd/env.
Checks .bat/.CMD and trailing-dot batch paths against std, with no INJECTED marker and literal argument recovery.
Runs convertible verbatim batch paths but refuses overlong ones; CR/LF arguments and percent-bearing script paths must not create a canary, while a valid positive control does.
Compares verbatim tails with std raw_arg and refuses batch, extra argv or NUL combinations.
contracts: The supervisor must either preserve the stated literal semantics or refuse before any script executes.
dependencies: windows_host.rs protocol fixture; windows_child argv/raw-line role; production cmdline.rs and spawn.rs; Rust std differential baseline.
failures_or_limits: The finite corpus is a targeted quoting regression set, not exhaustive shell equivalence. The raw-line comparison uses the std version that would compile/run the test, while production attributes a pinned source port; no differential run occurred.

purpose: Specify Windows root containment, narrow handle inheritance, error typing and handle lifetime stability.
behavior: Requires the child to report a one-member kill-on-close Job with breakaway refused, then verifies NUL/pipe/merged/separate stdio behavior.
Creates an inheritable event and checks positive controls in the supervisor and a direct std child, while the contained root must not hold that object.
Checks missing/invalid program, bad cwd, NUL, relative path and absent/repeated transferred-handle errors; a repeated pipe must close once so its reader reaches EOF.
Checks full 32-bit exit values and thirty cycles of success/Stop/Release plus failed spawns, allowing at most three additional supervisor handles.
contracts: Same-object native handle comparison supports the inheritance oracle; a numeric handle absence alone is insufficient.
dependencies: windows_host.rs and windows_os.rs Proc/pipe helpers; windows_child job/stdin/exit roles.
failures_or_limits: The inheritance control uses the test host std::process launch, not the production host no-inheritance startup path. Handle-count slack and a finite cycle count are regression thresholds; all assertions remain unexecuted.

purpose: Specify Windows whole-Job inventory, shared stopping, lifecycle failure cleanup and console isolation.
behavior: Checks parent/name inventory, graceful CTRL_BREAK exit, resistant trees forced at the earliest overlapping deadline, and descendant cleanup after root exit.
Requires every request on unknown/released IDs to return Unknown while Release alone leaves the process alive and host loss still cleans it.
Exercises channel disconnect/malformed frames, killed or flooding host, and supervisor death; a direct std child remains a host-death control, and host console events remain isolated.
Checks idle-period grace, logs descendants born after the graceful-stop barrier with PID/creation identity, and requires nested Job stopping below the one-second fallback.
contracts: Independent Proc handles and creation-time comparisons check death, not just protocol Stopped/List.
dependencies: windows_host sub-hosts; windows_child chain/breed/nest roles; windows_os::gone identity oracle.
failures_or_limits: The breeding test validates parseable logged descendants and at least three entries; it does not prove every unlogged process was observed. Ordinary cases assert full death, while separate unit tests intentionally cover the unresolved-member proof fallback. No suite execution is claimed.
